plugins.name: hypd-ai-ads
plugins.description: Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Google Analytics (GA4) and Merchant Center analysis in plain language. Campaign performance, ROAS breakdowns, wasted-spend checks, creative and audience insights, funnels and attribution, Shopping feed diagnostics, keyword and competitor research, and landing-page checks. Read-only: HYPD reports on your accounts and never changes your campaigns.

skills.name: hypd-getting-started
skills.description: Connect HYPD and your ad accounts. Use when HYPD is not connected yet, a HYPD tool returns an authentication error, or the user asks how to set up or start using HYPD.
skills.description_zh: 配置 HYPD 与广告账号连接，处理尚未接入、认证错误或首次使用的设置问题。

skills.name: hypd-overview
skills.description: What the HYPD plugin can do — platforms, analyses and slash commands. Use when the user asks what HYPD is, what it can do, or which command fits their task.
skills.description_zh: 介绍 HYPD 支持的广告平台、分析功能和斜杠命令，帮助理解能力并选择适合任务的入口。

skills.name: hypd-tools
skills.description: How HYPD's tools work and the invariants to respect when calling them. Load before the first HYPD tool call in a session.
skills.description_zh: 说明 HYPD 工具的调用方式及必须遵守的约束，适用于会话中首次调用前的操作准备。

commands.name: attribution
commands.description: Compare GA4 attribution models — Data-Driven vs Last-Click — and show where credit moves

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Full Google Ads account audit — structure, settings, tracking and performance, ranked by impact

commands.name: creative
commands.description: Analyze ad creatives — your own account, uploads, or competitors via the ad libraries

commands.name: feed-audit
commands.description: Audit Merchant Center feed quality — disapprovals, attributes, identifiers, custom labels

commands.name: keywords
commands.description: Keyword research — for a new search campaign or to expand an existing one, with volumes and CPCs

commands.name: landing-page
commands.description: Technical landing-page audit — speed, quality and conversion checks on a live URL

commands.name: meta-audit
commands.description: Full Meta Ads account audit, tailored to ecommerce or lead-gen automatically

commands.name: negatives
commands.description: Mine search terms for negative keyword candidates in a Google Ads account

commands.name: prompts
commands.description: Browse HYPD's full prompt library — ready-to-run analyses by category and platform

commands.name: report
commands.description: Client-ready monthly performance report for a Google Ads account

commands.name: wasted-spend
commands.description: Find wasted Google Ads spend and efficiency losses, with the money behind each finding
